en: In Amos 1, fire will devour Teman and which other Edomite city?
In Amos 3, God will strike the winter house with which other house?
In Amos 4, which body part does God mention when sending famine?
In Amos 6, if how many men remain in one house, they die?
In Amos 6, the revelers do not grieve over whose ruin?
In Amos 7, what devours the great abyss in the second vision?
In Amos 7, by what structure is the Lord standing in the third vision?
In Amos 7, which king does Amaziah say will die by the sword?
In Amos 8, what food does Amos see in a vision?
In Amos 9, God will shake Israel as grain is shaken in what?
